description: This Java source file defines the NotificationUpdateService class, which extends WearableListenerService to handle wearable device notifications. It manages data item changes and deletions via GoogleApiClient, builds notifications, and handles dismiss actions for wearable notifications in an Android environment.

classes.name: NotificationUpdateService
classes.description: A service that listens for data item changes on a wearable device, manages notifications, and handles dismiss actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient for wearable API communication.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, particularly dismiss actions for notifications.

methods.name: dismissPhoneNotification
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient to initiate notification dismissal.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Processes data item changes and deletions to update or dismiss notifications.

methods.name: buildWearableOnlyNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification on the wearable device, with optional dismissal handling.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Deletes data items on the wearable device upon connection to synchronize notification state.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of the GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of data item deletion, logs failure if unsuccessful.
